anchorMode: reference until G2, golden frames after G2

anchors.10: indistinguishable in mood and quality from the anchor at game resolution
anchors.7: a player would screenshot this; minor issues only
anchors.5: competent tech demo; the style is recognisable but generic

dimensions.ask: Key direction, warmth and elevation vs bible; shadow softness and tint; rim; fill not flattening form.
At every hour shot: player, path and entrances readable; every lamp-like emissive casts visible light; dusk not darker than midnight; morning not washed out.
Frame palette vs bible palette for that hour; no colours from the avoid list; accents used sparingly.
Material families read correctly (stone, timber, glass...); texture scale; no emissive placeholders; no flat 'wallpaper' interiors.
Card size and softness vs bible; no dark fringes or rims, no lichen noise, no edge-on slivers; density not cluttered.
Silhouette language from the bible; plinths, eaves, mullions; not a box on a plinth.
Adult proportions; identity matches persona (name, gender, role); no clipping; no outline speckle at dialogue distance; natural idle, no foot sliding.
Bible targets (focal height %, player x, horizon, empty sky); brightest value is the focal point; clear leading line; simplification honoured.
Depth via fog and aerial perspective without milky wash; sky quality; particles subtle and not reading as UI artefacts.
Every visible panel, prompt, map and menu: legible (contrast over the actual backdrop), minimal, consistent with the bible.
Phone frames: framing in portrait, touch controls not covering the focal point, text legible at interaction distance.
z-fighting or flicker, light leaks, black surfaces, popping, floating meshes, hard shadow-frustum edges, unrequested text or logos.
Overall: does this read as a shipped game rather than a demo?

rules: Cite a shot id for every claim.
At least one fix per dimension scored below 7.
Every fix: {priority P0-P3, area, problem, fix, files, params} with numbers where possible.
Re-measure; never accept a builder's or integrator's claim without looking.
List regressions vs the previous round explicitly.
A dimension below 5 for two consecutive rounds is P0.
Excluded elements from triage are not penalised for being absent.
